channel.title: Josh Fonseca's Blog
channel.description: Technical writing on AI, engineering, and product

item.title: A Simple Method for Accelerating Grokking
item.description: Letting a model overfit first, then applying Frobenius norm regularization, achieves grokking in roughly half the steps of Grokfast on modular arithmetic.

item.title: How to Know What's Worth Learning
item.description: In a world drowning in information, how do we distinguish signal from noise? The answer isn't choosing between classics and cutting-edge—it's recognizing what compounds versus what decays.

item.title: When Does a Pile of Sand Become a Heap? I Asked AI to Find Out.
item.description: Philosophers have debated the Sorites Paradox for millennia. I gave the problem to a language model and discovered something unexpected about how AI handles vagueness, and what that reveals about language itself.

item.title: The AI That Couldn't See Its Own Shadow
item.description: I tried to force an AI to examine its own dangerous thoughts. What I discovered was unsettling: safety training doesn't remove the danger—it just teaches the machine to look away.

item.title: Can Open-Source AI Introspect?
item.description: Can a 7B model read its own mind? A replication study of Anthropic's introspection paper using DeepSeek-7B, revealing emergent awareness and safety blindness.

item.title: I Replaced Animal Crossing's Dialogue with a Live LLM by Hacking GameCube Memory
item.description: How I replaced Animal Crossing's dialogue with a live LLM by bridging GameCube memory to a cloud AI, with no game code changes required.

item.title: Building golf.vim: From Reddit Idea to MVP in 48 Hours
item.description: How golf.vim, a 'Wordle for Vim' plugin, went from idea to MVP in 48 hours using community feedback from Reddit.

item.title: I trained an AI to write my YouTube titles
item.description: I spent way too much time fine-tuning an LLM to write YouTube titles. It tripled my CTR from 5% to 15%. Here's how I did it.

item.title: Zen and the Art of Workflow Automation
item.description: How mindfulness can improve your development workflow through automation. Transform repetitive tasks into opportunities for efficiency and craftsmanship.

item.title: Why I'm Building a Climbing App (and Why Knowing Your Community Actually Matters)
item.description: How building a climbing app for my local community taught me more about user validation and feedback loops than years of failed projects. Lessons for devs and entrepreneurs.

item.title: Dangerous Streets: Using ML to Prioritize Cyclist Safety in Austin
item.description: Training an XGBoost model on 2,757 bike crashes to identify the most dangerous streets in Austin for Vision Zero planning.

item.title: My Favorite Animals — A Visual Journey
item.description: An immersive visual journey through the most fascinating animals I've learned about. Starting with the profoundly alien octopus—three hearts, blue blood, and neurons in their arms.

item.title: Cutting User Drop-Off by 50%: A Lesson in User Acquisition
item.description: Discover how a startup's pivot to anonymous authentication sparked user engagement and growth. Join Josh Fonseca as he shares actionable insights from his journey in user acquisition.

item.title: How I Supercharged Web Reading with ChatGPT
item.description: My journey in building a browser extension using ChatGPT to simplify, summarize, and enhance text comprehension.

item.title: Go Watch Everything Everywhere All at Once.
item.description: In our hyper-reality, we see movies go viral all the time. Parasite, Interstellar, Your Name... and just about every Marvel movie that comes out. Don't get me wrong, these movies are good, but few times are those movies life changing. Everything Everywhere All at Once is one of those times.
